name: What is stucco resurfacing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Stucco resurfacing is the process of applying a new layer of stucco finish over existing stucco. This procedure can repair cosmetic damage, improve the aesthetic appeal, and enhance the durability of your home's exterior without requiring a complete removal of the old stucco. It's a cost-effective way to refresh the look of your property, addressing issues like minor cracks, discoloration, or outdated textures. The new layer bonds with the old, creating a fresh, uniform surface.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco resurfacing applies a new stucco layer over existing stucco to repair damage and update appearance.
